name: GIN-Wallpaper-Calend
description: Smart Desktop Wallpaper with Calendar for Windows 10/11 (Added Motorcycles to Cars, added new Truck & 4x4 Off-Road category, added Girls & Aesthetic Portraits SFW category, 14 categories total, trilingual EN/CS/RU, ultra-minimal installer)
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev
features: Expanded Cars category to 'Cars & Motorcycles' (supercars, sports cars, motorcycles, superbikes, custom choppers)
Added brand-new 'Trucks & 4x4 Off-Road' category (semi-trucks, big rigs, off-road 4x4, SUVs, overland vehicles)
Added brand-new 'Girls & Aesthetic Portraits' category strictly SFW / 100% safe (fashion models, beauty portraiture, aesthetic female portraits with zero vulgarity)
Full trilingual localization across all 14 categories: English (EN default), Czech (CS), and Russian (RU)
Minimal English-only installer ('GIN-Wallpaper-Calend - Install?') and completely silent uninstaller (0 popups)
Soft organic double-drop bubble chime on update completion and ~1.5-2 MB idle RAM consumption
